description:
Date night, decided.

DateMeUp ends the "I don't know, what do you want to do?" loop. Add a few ideas, everyone votes, and the plan locks in as soon as you agree. It works for couples, friends and groups of any size.

HOW IT WORKS
• Start a group and invite your partner or friends with a link.
• Add ideas yourself, or pull them from Discover: restaurants, movies, events and things to do near you.
• Everyone votes: I'm in, Maybe, or Not for me.
• When everyone's in, it's a plan. Everyone sees the time, the place and the details.

MADE FOR REAL PLANS
• Tonight near you: quick ideas for when you want to go out now.
• Swipe through ideas one at a time, or see them all at once.
• So close? If most of the group is in, suggest a different time or place and vote again.
• Talk it over in each plan's discussion before you decide.
• Share the plan with a ticket-style invite card.
• Rate the date afterwards and keep a record of your plans.
• After Dark: bars, late shows and nightlife ideas for adults (optional).

YOURS, ON EVERY DEVICE
DateMeUp works on iPhone, iPad, Android and the web at datemeup.app, and your groups stay in sync everywhere. Export or delete your data any time from Settings.

Questions? support@datemeup.app
play_short: Suggest ideas, vote together, and lock in date night or group plans in minutes.
